label: Pop
blueprintGuidance: Represent modern pop: clear hook, clean structure, accessible melody, and polished production.
Keep the chorus simple enough to remember after one listen.
Use the separate mood field for emotional color instead of changing the genre identity.
generationGuidance: Use clean drums, supportive bass, polished keys or synths, and a focused lead vocal.
Keep the arrangement balanced and radio-ready without crowding the hook.
Make transitions clean and predictable: intro, hook arrival, short development, ending.
For short-form output, make the hook appear early and stay easy to loop.
avoidGuidance: Avoid random genre switching, long intros, and excessive instrumental solos.
Avoid muddy low-end, harsh cymbals, and stacked parts that hide the vocal.
